result.title: How to Build Apps and Automate Tasks with Google Antigravity 2.0
result.description:
Google Antigravity 2.0 is your standalone desktop command center, designed to run autonomous AI agents in parallel. Watch this video to see AI agents plan, build, test, and execute complex workflows simultaneously. 

Antigravity also comes as CLI, an IDE, and SDK.

This site is a great resource to guide you as you ramp up on all things Antigravity: https://antigravity.google/
